name: AniWorld Requests
description: Language-aware requests, movie/series destinations and owner-checked download deletion for H0melab Downloader.
overview: Search enabled sources, request the right language, route films and series to separate libraries, and manage your own downloads.
changelog: Grouped episode-page series with stable provider references; central movie/show destinations shared with the downloader; standardized season/episode paths; resumable large series requests. Preserves language checks and owner-checked deletion. Requires H0melab Downloader 2.3.0 or newer.
